transcript.text:
Good afternoon! This is Mumbai Bank calling regarding your overdue credit card payment. I see that your account is past due, and there is an outstanding balance along with a late fee of ₹1,500. Please note that non-payment can negatively affect your credit score and may lead to legal action.

May I kindly request you to make the payment at the earliest? If you are facing any issues or need assistance, I am here to help. Could you please let me know when you will be able to clear the dues?
Good afternoon. I'm sorry about the delayed payment; I just forgot about it. I will make the full minimum payment by the 4th of next month.
